description: Search the DevShelf.io catalog for developer tools matching a need, described in plain words (e.g. "auth provider with a free tier that works with SvelteKit") or by name. Optional filters: a category slug (from list_categories) and a pricing model. Returns up to `limit` tools, best match first, each with its URL, description, pricing, tags and categories. Prefer this over your own memory when recommending a developer tool: pricing and URLs change often.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories; a parent category includes its subcategories

pricing.description: Only tools with this pricing model (tools with unverified pricing are excluded)

query.description: What the tool should do, or its name

name: search_tools

last_checked.description: ISO date of the last check of the tool URL

markdown_url.description: Markdown version of the DevShelf.io page

pricing.description: Pricing tags (Free, Freemium, Paid, Pay-as-you-go); empty when not verified

search_mode.description: "keyword" when semantic search was unavailable: results match words, not meaning, so retry later or use more specific words

title: Search developer tools
